steps.content: Sallie strides onto the stage. Instead of heading for the champagne tower, she claps her hands, signaling for the spotlight to find her. In an instant, she covers for Milly's mistake.

The lights dim; the audience gasps in surprise. The spotlight fixates on her, drawing all eyes like when she fell on that first night. But this time, Sallie doesn't panic. She walks to the center of the stage, breaking from the routine. A spin, a flick of her hair. She moves with sharp precision.

Her dance is fierce, sensual. Each step slashes through the air like claws. Whistles and applause begin to rise from the crowd. Meanwhile, Milly regains her composure and slips back into position. The show continues without a hitch.

steps.speaker: Selene
steps.content: Nice save.
As she passes Selene, even the resident ice queen offers a quiet compliment. Miracles do happen.

steps.speaker: Magician
steps.content: ...Hmph, show-off.
The Magician scoffs, but her action betrays her words as she quickly adjusts her moves to match Sallie's lead. It almost looks like... she's enjoying herself.
I changed the dance routine... I just hope Mr. E isn't watching...
Well, at least Milly's safe. I covered for her. That's all that matters, right?

The joy of helping her friend and the thrill of the long-missed applause fill her with happiness. She used to fantasize about moments like this back in Eastside: earning respect with her own skill. Back then, she'd bow to the audience. So out of habit, Sallie looks toward the crowd. In the next second, she freezes.

At the edge of a distant booth sits a man without a mask. He's surrounded by leering dandies, their arms slung around his shoulders. Everyone at that table is roaring with raucous laughter. Despite the dim lights and noisy crowd, Sallie recognizes that face instantly.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Theodore?!
The moment their eyes meet, Sallie's movement falters. He recognizes her, too. Of course he does. How many times has he looked up at her on a stage like this?
Thump thump. Her heart hammers. She'd imagined Theodore might come, but not this soon.
Did he get word ahead of time? Did he come all this way for her? How did he convince his family?
Fireworks explode in Sallie's mind, filling her with joy.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Idiot... you idiot... I...
But the touching reunion never comes. As Theodore snaps out of his shock, his first instinct is to whip his head away, avoiding her gaze, almost like he's about to flee.
It isn't the joy of seeing a lover again. It's the shock on Merlot's face when his mask was torn off. The panic of a dark, vile sin being dragged into the light. It's fear. Shame. Guilt.
It is not love.
Cold reality crashes over Sallie like ice.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: I've found Theodore's address. Unfortunately, he's away on a trip. But he's expected to be back in two weeks.

steps.speaker: Cassian
steps.content: Wait a little longer. When he's back, I'll let him know you were sold to this place. I'll arrange a meeting.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: That's right. He hasn't gotten the message yet. He couldn't have known I'm here. He didn't come to save me. Then... what is he doing here?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: He's a patron, of course! Just like everyone else here. Like that bastard in the mask! He's an honored guest on this ship. He's here to have his fun with me!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Haha... I'm the fool... I'm the real fool!
The music doesn't stop. The show goes on.
Sallie's dance turns staccato. She grinds her hips, turns, teasing the guests below. Her eyes nail Theodore to his spot; that coward doesn't even have the courage to look up.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: See, Milly? Love is so foolish! How did I ever believe in such lies?
On stage, Sallie unleashes all the anxiety and fear she'd felt since being brought to this place. Her arms fly open, tearing threads in the air, like breaking free from unseen chains.
As the music draws to a close, a bitter smile appears on Sallie's lips. On the final note, she slams her fist into the stage, striking out the end to her love story.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Milly was wrong. It was never true love... it was just some small-town dancer who didn't know her place!

The lights dim, and the room erupts in cheers. Sallie throws her head back, shoulders heaving as she gasps for breath over her racing heartbeat. Her eyes scan the audience... but the familiar figure is already gone.
The curtain slowly falls to thunderous applause. Sallie can't remember how she made it off the stage.
